title: Each element when the plan changes
caption:
The plan changed. Four elements, four completely different reactions.

Air is thrilled. Fire was ready at 6:45 and is now rebooking the table. Water didn't notice. Earth is calmly recalculating everything and will mention it in three weeks.

The useful bit: tell Fire the new time fast, tell Earth the reason, tell Air who's coming. Water will be fine.

Send this to the group chat that cancels everything.
